display_long_description:
Cast spells using your voice and become the ultimate monke mage!

Doth thou wish to be magick?  Art thou a monke?  Then thou shouldst become a Monke Mage!   Thou canst turn thy friends into a frog. Thou canst suck thy friends into a twirly whirly. Thou canst light thine friends on fire.  Then thou canst laugh at thy friends as they die.  All with the power of thy voice and thy magic wand!

Thou canst unlock new mage ranks by successfully killing other monkes!  Can thou become a Grand Master?

Monke Mages doth come with 5 free spells and 1 free map, and thou canst unlock all 12 spells and the magic arena map for only one of thine dollars!

But be careful oh precious monke, in the magic arena thou mayest also summon enemies that will crush thee with a somewhat large hammer or bite thee many times without reproach. 

Doth ye have what it doth take to be a monke mage?
